source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Nominations for county and rural councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page image: the News-Letter's Ballycastle section lists each division with its nominee (no party labels printed; the recorded party is not from this page). The Northern Whig's list of the same day (p. 3), cited before, does not carry this council.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Fourteen members were returned. Glenariff had two nominations, but Joseph Lynn was returned unopposed after the withdrawal of Alexander Stewart; the other divisions were unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Citation corrected (w19-bna-fix, Nov 2026): the Northern Whig page cited before (20 September 1946, p. 3) has no Ballycastle list; the member is named in the Belfast News-Letter of the same day, p. 3 (page image), which prints no party labels, so Party_As_Printed is cleared (the recorded party is kept).
